introduction: Ohio’s earned income credit reduces state income tax for eligible taxpayers who qualify for federal EITC.
description: Ohio’s earned income credit reduces state income tax for eligible taxpayers who qualify for federal EITC.

sections.who: Federal EITC eligibility and Ohio filing requirements apply. Use instructions for the tax year you are filing.
sections.get: The statute provides a nonrefundable state credit equal to 30% of federal EITC. It cannot exceed the remaining Ohio tax after applicable preceding credits.
sections.docs:
• Federal return and EITC calculation.
  • Wage and self-employment records.
  • The Ohio return and instructions for the same year.
sections.apply:
1. Complete the federal calculation

    Determine federal EITC eligibility using the relevant year’s rules.

  2. Use current state forms

    Follow the Ohio return instructions and transfer the credit amount to the specified place.

  3. Save your records

    Keep both returns and the supporting calculation.
sections.after: Read any tax-agency notice carefully and respond using its instructions. Do not reuse an old form’s line number.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Ohio Revised Code 5747.71. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can this credit itself produce a refund?
It is nonrefundable and offsets Ohio tax.
No. Claim it on the state income-tax return.
Yes. The state calculation is based on that credit.
Can I use a prior year’s form?
Use the forms matching the year being filed.
